key_facts: On November 1, 2024 at approximately 12:54 a.m., CHP Officers Santiago Meza-Gonzalez (#023295) and Jose Melano (#023054) contacted Plaintiff on the eastbound I-580 dirt shoulder near Isabel Avenue, Livermore (CHP Case No. RJ68845; CAD No. 241101GG0064). Plaintiff prepared an N.D. Cal. § 1983 complaint (v3, 20 pp., six causes) and a print intake packet under the Ngwa Nforbi name form, demanding compensatory damages >$214,000, then drafted a First Amended Complaint on the same six causes. The court-stamped operative FAC is Dkt. 5 (filed Aug. 17, 2026, 21 pp., dated Aug. 17); Dkt. 6 (filed Aug. 14, dated Aug. 12) is the earlier stamped FAC. The unsigned Aug. 12 draft is retained. Draft versions v1 (31 pp., long-form), v2 (18 pp., five claims, no retaliation), and the Aug. 10/Aug. 11 FAC drafts are retained as superseded. The FAC's ¶36(d) pleads a three-year SR-22 requirement (annual premium $281.28) with a maintenance period extending through approximately May 2029 — the same end date the Candelaria FAC pleads. Matter 32 also remains the portfolio PDF home for Matters 1/2/20/24 under from-NN/; Nov. 1 / APS evidence and Candelaria filings live in Matter 33.
procedural_status: RELATED-CASE ORDER (Aug. 24, 2026): Mag. Krishnan granted the Serrato admin motion (Civil L.R. 3-12); this action is related to 4:26-cv-05953-ASK and is to be reassigned to Krishnan; CMC will be rescheduled (Dec. 2, 2026 Kang CMC no longer controlling). Opened as Matter 32 (CHP-cluster PDF home). Plaintiff drafted successive N.D. Cal. complaints (v1 → v2 → v3 Operative) and a print intake packet (filled JS-44 citing related Serrato 4:26-cv-05953-ASK; AO 440 summonses for Meza-Gonzalez @ CHP Modesto and Melano @ CHP South Sacramento; MJ consent/declination), then filed the packet. The Court docketed it Aug. 10, 2026 as No. 3:26-cv-08271-PHK, assigned to Magistrate Judge Peter H. Kang. Four documents are on the docket: Complaint (Dkt. 1, 31 pp., plus Dkt. 1-1 filing-fee receipt and Dkt. 1-2 JS-CAND 44 civil cover sheet), Plaintiff's Consent to Magistrate Judge Jurisdiction (Dkt. 2, signed Aug. 7), Summons issued as to both officers (Dkt. 3 — Meza-Gonzalez @ CHP Modesto, Melano @ CHP South Sacramento), and the Court's Order Setting Initial Case Management Conference and ADR Deadlines (Dkt. 4 — CMC Dec. 2, 2026 at 11:00 a.m., Courtroom F, 450 Golden Gate Ave., San Francisco; ADR certification and Rule 26(f) conference deadline Nov. 12, 2026; initial disclosures and Joint CMC Statement due Nov. 25, 2026). FAC filings: Dkt. 6 First Amended Complaint (CONFORMED, filed Aug. 14, 2026, 21 pp., dated Aug. 12) and Dkt. 5 First Amended Complaint (CONFORMED, filed Aug. 17, 2026, 21 pp., dated Aug. 17) — Dkt. 5 is the operative court pleading of record. Melano AO 440 proof of service filed Aug. 17 as Dkt. 5-1. The unsigned Aug. 12 draft and the Aug. 10/Aug. 11 drafts are superseded. Both officers were personally served Aug. 14, 2026 — Meza-Gonzalez via the Stanislaus County Sheriff at CHP Modesto Area, Melano via the Sacramento County Sheriff at CHP South Sacramento Area — satisfying the Rule 4(m) window (had run to Nov. 8, 2026) and setting the answer/Rule 12 motion deadline at Sep. 4, 2026 (FRCP 12(a)(1)(A)(i), 21 days). Open items: designate the Candelaria action (3:26-cv-08272-LJC) as related under Civil L.R. 3-12 (Serrato-side related-cases admin motion filed Aug. 20, 2026 in Matter 24); confirm Meza-Gonzalez proof of service is on the docket (Melano POS is Dkt. 5-1). Source-matter PDFs for Matters 1/2/20/24 remain under from-01|02|20|24/; Candelaria / APS ownership is Matter 33. On September 1, 2026 Plaintiff mailed the DAG Li accept-service administrative-motion packet First-Class from San Jose (USPS eReceipt; inferred 3.70 oz pieces to the N.D. Cal. clerk, DAG Li, Melano, and Meza). Clerk-stamped Sep. 3 as Dkt. 13. Signed Meza Rule 4 return received Sep. 8 (Fischer / Run With It order 15645547; substitute service Aug. 27 on Kim S. - H.R. at CHP Modesto Area). Unfiled. CCP §415.20 mailing follow-up is not on the face of that return — do not start Meza's FRCP 12 clock from Aug. 27 until mailing is confirmed or Li accepts service.
damages: The Dkt. 5 FAC seeks compensatory damages exceeding $214,000 (Centerline rates $33.35 / $50.03), plus punitive damages according to proof, and attorney fees under 42 U.S.C. § 1988. State-court Matter 2 damages remain separate.
